His partner, Emily, was sitting with her back straight, her eyes fixed on some point outside the window, while he was leaning in, his face tilted towards her. "I'm really glad we're doing this," Jack said, trying to break the ice. "I feel like we haven't had a chance to talk about us in a while. " Emily nodded, her expression neutral. "Yeah, I know what you mean. " Jack took a deep breath and continued, "I just want to make sure we're on the same page. You know, about our relationship and where we're headed. " Emily shifted uncomfortably in her seat, her eyes darting away from his. "We're fine, Em. We're good. " Jack's heart sank. He knew that tone, that body language. It was the same way she always reacted when he tried to get close, when he tried to express his feelings. It was as if she was shutting down, pulling up walls around herself.

Jack's eyes locked onto Emily's, searching for a glimmer of emotion, but her expression remained guarded. He knew that look all too well - it was the same one she wore whenever he tried to have a deep conversation or express his feelings. It was as if she was afraid to let him in, to let him see the real her. He sighed inwardly, feeling a familiar sense of frustration. Why was it so hard for her to open up to him?
